source.formula: X + 2*Y + 3*Z evaluated at geometry-v1 ERP pixel centres

shared_sample_policy: Only the central sample of odd perspective/cube outputs is compared. py360convert 1.0.4 uses boundary-inclusive output lattices while PanorAi uses pixel-centre lattices, so non-central samples are not the same rays.

excluded_cross_library_cases.up_down_face_centers: Exact ERP poles have no unique longitude. py360convert and geometry-v1 choose different raster representatives, so these samples are tested against the analytical axis oracle instead of cross-library numeric equality.
excluded_cross_library_cases.pyequilib_0_6_0: Pinned for later performance work but not used as a geometry-v1 numeric oracle because its documented +X-forward/+Z-up frame and raster mapping differ from geometry-v1.
